title: CHU de Guadeloupe hit by a cyberattack; plan blanc triggered and non-urgent care postponed
date_note: RCI (22 November) says the hospital has been under attack since 21h on Saturday evening, 21 November (local time).
geo_basis: hospital's Pointe-à-Pitre site, named by RCI as one of the three affected sites
summary: RCI reported that the CHU de la Guadeloupe has been under cyberattack since Saturday evening, 21 November, with telephone, imaging and software down. La 1ère says part of the databases was encrypted and, in a later report, that management received no ransom demand. Génération NT, citing a hospital press release, reports a full recovery of several weeks.
plain: The main hospital in Guadeloupe was hit by a cyberattack on Saturday night. Phones, imaging and software are down, according to RCI. Génération NT reports full recovery may take several weeks.
exec: A regional hospital lost phones, imaging and software to a cyberattack and postponed care; Génération NT reports several weeks to full recovery, a reminder to test downtime procedures.
action: As La 1ère relays, the SAMU head advises against going to the hospital without first calling the emergency medical line; urgent and priority care continues.

evidence.quote: plusieurs semaines avec un rétablissement complet
Une partie des bases de données de l'établissement a été chiffrée

key_findings: Cyberattack since 21h Saturday 21 November; crisis cell set up
Telephone, imaging, non-urgent biology, printers and software out at the Pointe-à-Pitre, Perrin and Palais Royal sites
Director Eric Guyader: first exchanges with ANSSI were not encouraging; restoring software and databases will be difficult and not done within 2 or 3 days; non-urgent activity postponed for the week

validation.note: Three publishers (RCI, La 1ère, Génération NT) report the attack from 21 November and director Eric Guyader's statements; the CHU's own notice was not read. The provider-compromise account is the director's (La 1ère: reportedly hacked some months earlier); Génération NT relays it from a hospital press release.

review.note: stronger than the source / attribution: 'databases encrypted' is 'part of the databases' (La 1ère); provider-hack attributed to director via AFP; several-weeks recovery now attributed to Génération NT (La 1ère says several days of work) in summary, plain, exec
